item.coloph: gtad sprug gi yang snying rtsa ba'i gzung 'di / sbar zhabs brag dkar gyi gter ma / khod spung blo gros thog med dngos grub legs so / gong nas rim bzhin brgyud de khro bo rgyal mtshan bdag gis zhus so
item.note: the colophon gives the name khro-bo rgyal-mtshan, and he refers to himself in first-person as a receiver of the transmission from the gter ston. he is probably the person of that name whose biography is told in dpal-tshul, history (tbmc edition), vol. 2, p. 353, line 5 ff.
